bullets.title: NVDA: Vera Rubin on track, H200 shipments to China commence, MS estimates 1GW capex at $35–49bn
bullets.body: Huang confirmed Vera Rubin is already in production. A U.S. official confirmed H200 AI GPU shipments to China have begun, with ~10 firms cleared including Alibaba, Tencent, and DeepSeek; estimates range up to 200K units vs prior 75K. Morgan Stanley pegs 1GW data center buildout at ~$35bn (GB200) to ~$49bn (Vera Rubin), with Jensen suggesting next-gen could approach $100bn.

bullets.title: NOW: Oppenheimer raises PT to $140, Citi cuts to $156, Mizuho likes setup — mixed signals into July 22 earnings
bullets.body: Oppenheimer reiterates Outperform and raises PT to $140 from $130, citing 2Q CRPO whisper $13.3B+ (~300bps above consensus) and strong AI adoption in production. Citi cuts PT to $156 (from $158) on mixed partner checks — customer confusion on pricing/packaging, 10% of CIOs considering cutting NOW for AI budget, federal revenue down 77% y/y in 2Q — but maintains Buy. Mizuho names NOW a preferred software name ahead of earnings.

bullets.title: MSFT: Citi raises PT to $570, Mizuho cuts to $490 — Copilot bullish, FY27 capex at $261B a concern
bullets.body: Citi maintains Buy and raises PT to $570 (from $620 cut due to multiple compression), expecting Q4 Azure ~40% growth and M365 Copilot net adds of +8M. FY27 capex guided at $261B (+79% y/y) vs Street $232B; expects conservative FY27 margin guidance down 100-150bps. Mizuho cuts PT to $490 from $515, also Outperform; reseller survey shows LTM growth 13% but NTM growth decelerating to 11% with 22% of resellers missing quota.

bullets.title: INTC: Citi Buy maintained — models 2Q26 beat, data center up 37% YoY, foundry to $4.6B by 2027
bullets.body: Citi models 2Q26 sales $14.4B (+6% q/q) and EPS $0.24, both above consensus; data center segment forecast $23.1B in 2026 (+37% y/y). Intel foundry external sales modeled at $4.6B in 2027 and $10B in 2028. ASML confirmed Intel is now in high-volume production on High-NA. Intel Foundry separately reported design wins from AMD, NVIDIA, and OpenAI on 18A/14A nodes.

bullets.title: AMD: UBS raises PT to $700 on AI Day catalyst — three large-scale customers, GPU revenue to $41B in C2027
bullets.body: UBS maintains Buy and raises AMD PT to $700 from $670, citing significant CoWoS allocation uptick for C2027. Expects MI450x (2026) and MI500 (2027) roadmap announcements at Advancing AI 2026 event; Amazon and Anthropic expected as MI450x customers. GPU revenue estimates raised to $41B C2027 and $61B C2028; supply chain signals path to $40-50B GPU revenue under 3-large-customer scenario.

bullets.title: AMAT/LRCX/KLAC: UBS raises PTs on pricing power — cumulative 5% ASP growth through C2028, WFE to $250B+
bullets.body: UBS raises AMAT PT to $705 (from $570), LRCX to $435 (from $375), KLAC to $255 (from $218), arguing equipment pricing leverage is underappreciated. Expects ~5% cumulative ASP growth through C2028, potentially 10%, adding $10-15B to WFE. Terafab could spend $300-500B similar to TSMC within 4-5 years.

bullets.title: TSM: Q2 earnings Thursday — consensus expects NT$1.27T revenue, net profit +59%, gross margin >68%
bullets.body: TSMC Q2 results due July 16; media reports project revenue NT$1.27 trillion, net profit NT$632.6B (US$19.6B, +59% y/y), marking the 10th consecutive quarter of profit growth with gross margin exceeding 68%. Google Pixel 11 reportedly driving the 2nm ramp-up. Citi hosting TSMC preview call.

bullets.title: ORCL: Most oversold large-cap tech (RSI 26), FCF at historic low — Jefferies notes apathy and OAI concerns
bullets.body: Oracle down 12 of last 15 sessions, ~26-62% from highs depending on source, with RSI at 26 — most oversold large-cap tech. FCF has plummeted to historic lows. Weakness driven by apathy among check-writers, OCI commitment concerns from hyperscalers (META/SPCX selling compute), and deal slippage. Oracle is separately leading the race to supply Japan's secret cloud services per FT.

bullets.title: SPOT: Solid Q2 setup into earnings — typical 20bps GM beat expected, show-me story on remix
bullets.body: Raymond James flags SPOT should have solid Investor Day-driven setup; typical 20bps Q2 gross margin beat possible vs Street 33.0% Q3 GM reasonable. Q3 regulatory GM charge step-down well understood. NFLX facing engagement pressure from short-form video ahead of Thursday July 16 earnings report.

bullets.title: TXN: Strong setup into July 22 earnings — data center share gain, Q guide ~$5.85B
bullets.body: Jefferies notes TXN positioning leans long into next week's print, with expected q/q revenue growth near or above the 12% guide. September quarter guidance expected around $5.85B. Data center share gain is the primary focus for investors.

bullets.title: MU: Closes above $1.1T market cap; SLC NAND forecast +120-170% H2; bullish options flow
bullets.body: Micron closed above $1.1T market cap, surpassing Berkshire Hathaway. SLC NAND contract prices forecast to surge 120-170% in H2 2026 per Trendforce as mature capacity shifts to higher-value 3D NAND, creating MLC shortage. MU has 21% SLC NAND market share. Options flow was described as 'incredibly bullish' on the day.

bullets.title: EQIX/DLR: Oppenheimer raises PTs — EQIX to $1,200, DLR to $230, on 25% AI demand growth vs 6% historical
bullets.body: Oppenheimer raises EQIX PT to $1,200 and DLR to $230, noting AI compute capacity demand growing ~25% per year vs 6% historically while EQIX/DLR are accelerating expansion to ~10% per year. Pricing growing 3-4% annually with strong operating leverage. Morgan Stanley separately raised European data center capacity forecasts by 15% through 2035 citing €1.5T investment opportunity.

bullets.title: NET: Mizuho raises PT to $310 (from $260); stock hits 52-week high on AI security/infrastructure momentum
bullets.body: Mizuho raises Cloudflare PT to $310 from $260, maintaining Outperform, as part of broader software upgrade wave. NET hit a new 52-week high during Tuesday's session. Cybersecurity demand broadly improved Q/Q after mixed 1Q, with AI security driving engagement.

bullets.title: CVNA: JPM bullish into Q2 — $785M EBITDA estimate, $100/sh 2030 target at <20x FY2 EV/EBITDA
bullets.body: JPM previews CVNA 2Q26 with EBITDA estimate $785M vs $769M consensus, using $3.5K retail GPU vs Street; sees 35-40% EBITDA CAGR with <20x FY2 EV/EBITDA 'highly compelling.' Base case implies ~$100/share by 2030. CVNA outgrowing largest peer by 35%+ units with ~3x higher unit economics. Stock up ~8% on the preview note.

bullets.title: UBER: Advanced talks to acquire Delivery Hero at ~€40/share (~€12B); PLTR, TEAM remain software top picks
bullets.body: JPM and GS TMT desks confirm Uber in advanced negotiations to acquire Delivery Hero at a price well above its recent €36 trading level, for ~€12B. Delivery Hero under shareholder pressure amid food-delivery consolidation. Among software, Mizuho names PLTR, TEAM, NOW as preferred into earnings.

bullets.title: BABA/AAPL: Alibaba Qwen AI integrated into Apple Intelligence in China — China regulatory approval obtained
bullets.body: China's Cyberspace Administration approved Apple Intelligence with Alibaba's Qwen AI integrated on-device. Apple plans China Intelligence launch by year-end, continuing work with Alibaba and Baidu. BABA +3.7% in pre-market on the news. Jefferies raises BABA overall EBITA on strong China ecommerce, AliCloud AI demand, with ARR hitting USD $1.5B (RMB 10B) earlier than expected in Jun quarter.

bullets.title: RCL: JPM maintains OW, $345 PT — 2Q net yield +1.8% vs +0.2% guide; 2H de-risked
bullets.body: Royal Caribbean posted 2Q net yield growth of +1.8% c/c vs management's +0.2% guide and Street +0.4%; EPS raised to $4.12 vs guide $3.83-3.93. FY26 EPS maintained at $17.30. 2H lowered slightly to +2.2% c/c due to Europe itinerary geopolitical impact; fuel costs -7% vs guidance provides ~$39M upside per 10% change. JPM overweight with $345 PT.

bullets.title: ETSY: JPM raises PT to $85, above-guide 2Q/2026 GMS estimates — Depop/eBay deal a catalyst
bullets.body: JPM raises ETSY PT from $78 to $85, maintaining Neutral; raises 2Q GMS +1% to +6% growth and 2026 GMS to +4%, above management guidance, on social commerce momentum. First q/q Active Buyer growth in two years. UK CMA cleared eBay's Depop acquisition (originally announced Feb 26), removing phase-2 risk. App GMS now ~47% of Etsy marketplace GMV, growing +11% y/y.

bullets.title: GEV: Gas turbine supply constrained until 2030 — supports multi-year pricing power
bullets.body: Social commentary notes new gas turbine delivery is booked until 2030, positioning GEV as structural beneficiary of AI/data center power demand and PJM grid shortfall. PJM separately failed to secure 7GW for 2028 stability, with market-clearing prices 70% higher than current capped levels.

bullets.title: SNDK: Argus initiates Hold; Citi initiates Buy at $57 PT (136% upside) — IPF readout 4Q26 next catalyst
bullets.body: Argus Research initiated SNDK (Sarepta Genetics/Syndax — context clarifies this is SNDX) with Hold, sending shares down 2.7% pre-market. Citi initiates Buy with $57 PT; key 4Q26 catalyst is Niktimvo Phase 2 readout in IPF (MAXPIRe trial), targeting ~32% relative FVC decline reduction vs placebo. Two new pipeline assets (menin inhibitor for MF and allosteric EGFR inhibitor) presented at R&D Day.
